# Music

Tracker modules, kept exactly as downloaded. `tools/import_music.py` converts
them for the game's soundbank (`audio/`). All are CC0 or public domain;
[LICENSES.md](../../../LICENSES.md) lists them with their sources.

| File | Title | Artist | Licence | Source | Used for |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `kosmo-the-cat/Menu Song.xm` | Calm and simple title music | Kosmo The Cat | CC0 1.0 | https://opengameart.org/content/calm-and-simple-title-music | Title and menus |
| `kosmo-the-cat/Wander in a dungeon.xm` | Wander in a dungeon | Kosmo The Cat | CC0 1.0 | https://opengameart.org/content/wander-in-a-dungeon | The Dungeon |
| `kosmo-the-cat/Evil boss.xm` | Evil boss music | Kosmo The Cat | CC0 1.0 | https://opengameart.org/content/evil-boss-music | Bosses |
| `beyond/beyond_-_pianotune.it` | Piano tune | Beyond | Public domain | https://modarchive.org/index.php?request=view_by_moduleid&query=213498 | The camp |
| `beyond/bnd-song0.it` | Song0 | Beyond | Public domain | https://modarchive.org/index.php?request=view_by_moduleid&query=184094 | The Sunken Sewers |
| `drozerix/ambient_starfield.xm` | Ambient Starfield | Drozerix | Public domain | https://modarchive.org/index.php?request=view_by_moduleid&query=174160 | The Crystal Caverns |
| `jam/crusaders.xm` | Crusaders | JAM | Public domain | https://modarchive.org/index.php?request=view_by_moduleid&query=177809 | The Molten Depths |

The Kosmo The Cat modules come from the `.7z` archives on those pages (the
XM sources of the tracks). "Public domain" is The Mod Archive's licence
attribution: per its licensing FAQ, the composer has released the module to
the public domain, free to use for any purpose.
